verdict.rationale: monday's developer docs show a broad API/agents/apps framework covering boards, items, webhooks, views, and agent management (monday-docs-3,6,7,9,10), suggesting significant API coverage, but there is no explicit claim or evidence that every UI action (e.g., full board/workspace admin, permissions, all automations) is exposed via API for full parity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 1:1 API-UI feature parity, independent verification that complex UI-only actions are scriptable, and confirmation of parity for admin/workspace-level settings.
